integrity: The exact Fourier proof supports all quantified parameters; a standard-library rational script reproduces finite checks. Novelty is a best-knowledge literature comparison, not an independent guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Even homogeneous screened cycles with positive screening, two nonempty color classes and one exact Rademacher quadratic form per class. No statement about arbitrary two-query estimators, odd cycles, weighted cycles, or inaccurate linear solves.
title: Checkerboard probing uniquely minimizes two-color trace variance on screened cycles
